plan.problem: v0.5 bakes part transforms once and can only rotate an entire static or deformable specimen
plan.currentContract: 36 immutable v1/v2 works; pure specimen loader, optional Touch, common RotationBody, single WebGL2 draw path and static previews
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: No retained immutable per-part render geometry or time-varying local transform layer, motion lifecycle, parameter validation or moving bounds
plan.design: Pure validated MotionPlayer compiles immutable per-part vertex data with base nonuniform scale applied once. Each frame evaluates independent analytic spin/swing/slide tracks and composes rigid rotations about scaled local pivots plus slide translation, then saved base rotation/position and display/view transforms. Existing shader receives per-part model matrices and unchanged materials; vertices/rest are not updated by playback. Conservative analytic full-motion bounds drive camera framing. Optional session motion controller is independent from rotation/Touch; initial static snapshots reuse actual geometry for CPU preview/native/picking QA.
